observations.rule: Diacritic kana codes below0x60 are converted to a base glyph and a dakuten/handakuten tile at the same column one grid row above. The auditor verified all50 literal aliases against source arithmetic and explicit charmap base codes.
The same raw tile can represent multiple source aliases: main0xcd is へ/ヘ, main0xd8 is り/リ; source diacritic aliases also share codes. Preserve alternatives; the matcher never chooses the first alias.

0x00..0x16 can denote text-script commands or diacritic kana depending on parser context. Symbol table lookup alone is not a valid global byte decoder. Source substitutions such as PLAYER/RIVAL expand data and are not pixel-derived OCR corrections.

PARA clears the interior after a visible wait; scrolling copies intermediate rows twice with source-frame waits. Down-arrow visibility is controlled separately during input waits. Neither static duration nor arrow presence proves an entire source message has ended.

Japanese Blue/Yellow add GA0x4a and DEXEND0x5f source controls; their text-command sound dispatch differs from Red/Green. Do not replace Japanese control behavior with an international-version assumption.

Source Unicode spellings include fullwidth digits/letters, ideographic spaces and source-specific ellipsis/middle-dot symbols. These must remain auditable source aliases. A future visible-output representation layer must comply with the already-frozen contract; this audit performs no text normalization.

Glyph data at reused tile codes cannot be merged without the active image profile. Compact HP/level/ID/No./PP labels require separate rendered-unit interpretation; those interpretations and viewport/shadow handling are not yet implemented.

sourceAcquisition.initialFailure: Git Windows Schannel returned SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS for all3 public clones; original logs retained in reports/gt-approval-shop-metadata-r2/clone-*.log
sourceAcquisition.resolution: Used per-command git -c http.sslBackend=openssl; TLS verification remained enabled and global Git configuration was not changed. All3 public sources acquired and commits pinned. External repository scripts were never executed.

rightsEvidence: No LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE-named file was found in any of the3 full pinned Git trees; this fact is not a legal permission claim. Graphics and derived pixel banks remain in ignored .cache and are excluded from product packages.
